rules: POST uses application/json; authorization uses Bearer header.
HTTP success and code=0 are both required; null data is not an authentication result.
Business user.id and IM userId are separate identities; do not infer equality.
Read apiAddr and wsAddr from IMToken, never from competitor configuration.
Request a token for the current platform; do not change the legacy server default.
A business or IM token does not prove SDK login, store readability, or sync completion.
The user authorized the existing backend as the default; see runtime-endpoints.json. Credentials are never embedded and all requests require explicit user actions.
Business login requests auth/login and me only; issuing an IM token is deferred until the actual SDK is connected.
Production signing and distribution remain blocked pending identity and migration checks.
